scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan. Could you please tell me the status of my application? Also, what type of loan was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: I'm sorry to inform you that your application for a housing loan was denied. The loan type you applied for was a conventional loan for a home purchase. The principal reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio was and what that means for my application? Also, are there any other reasons for the denial that I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio was greater than 60%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In this case, it indicates that your monthly debt payments were too high compared to your income, which contributed to the denial of your loan application. There are no other reasons for the denial besides the debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I understand. Thank you for explaining that. Can you tell me if my loan has been sold to another institution? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. Additionally, there are no high-cost flags or negative amortization features associated with your loan.

dialogue.user:
Got it. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I needed to know for now.

<Neutral>
I appreciate your help, but I'm a bit disappointed that my application was denied due to my debt-to-income ratio. I was hoping to secure the loan, but I understand the decision. The agent was polite and provided clear explanations, but the outcome wasn't what I had hoped for.
